name: agency-brief
title: {label}: intelligence brief as of {as_of}
objective: What the {label} is buying now, who holds the money and the work at the offices that matter most, and what changed, for a reader deciding where to engage.

sections.title: What the record holds
sections.question: What was read, how many rows, how recent, and what is absent
required_parts: each domain with its rows and newest date
what is absent from this record

sections.title: What carries {focus}
sections.question: The statements, forecast rows and offices that carry the focus term
required_parts: how many statements carry the term and in which families
the offices that carry it most

sections.title: Where {office} sits
sections.question: The office's parent and siblings, who contracts for it, who leads it, with sources
required_parts: the chain above the office up to the agency
the contracting office that buys for it
who leads it, current or ended, with the source

sections.title: Who holds the budget at {office}
sections.question: The budget lines and program rows placed in the office, with the basis of each placement, and what the lines name
required_parts: the lines placed in the office and the basis stated for each
enacted and request amounts as labelled
obligations this fiscal year where stated

sections.title: Who the record ties to {office}
sections.question: The people with a stated role at the office and the offices above it
required_parts: the source that ties them to it

sections.title: What {office} is buying now
sections.question: The office's open forecast rows and newest statements, its vendors, and the layers beside it
required_parts: open forecast rows or notices with identifiers
the top vendors on its awards

sections.title: Who holds the work at {office}
sections.question: The buying book of the office or the contracting office that buys for it: awards, vehicles, competition, small business share, top vendors

sections.title: What changed around {office}
sections.question: New or moved forecast rows, notices, topics and awards in the 90 days before the record's date

sections.title: What is said about {office}
sections.question: What leaders, Congress, the budget, oversight, conferences and news say in the office's chain
required_parts: each statement quoted with its date and family
which level of the chain said it

sections.title: The requirements most time-critical on {as_of}
sections.question: The ranked requirements across the agency and the dates that make each one time-critical
